notes.title: Get RAT MEMORY 40% off during the World Ocean Day Sale!
notes.content:
I’m proud to announce that Quero Games is supporting WDC, Whale and Dolphin Conservation for World Ocean Day!   

https://pbs.twimg.com/media/Gsr2-6rXcAE-YLF.jpg

The WDC World Ocean Day Sale starts today and runs until 12th June, 10am PDT 2025, and you can save 40% off RAT MEMORY! Also, I’ll donate 25% of the net profits to WDC to support their conservation work.*
*25% of net revenue from this sale (after Steam platform fees) will support WDC, Whale and Dolphin Conservation. WDC is a UK registered charity (no. 1014705).

How your support will help this year
By purchasing games from this year’s World Ocean Day sale, you will help WDC continue their global conservation work, as well as their ghost gear removal project, funding 10 missions for divers to remove lethal entanglement hazards to marine life (and scuba divers) from reefs, seabed and shipwrecks in UK seas.
Whales and dolphins are intelligent beings. The ocean produces more oxygen and absorbs more carbon than all of Earth's forests combined, and whales help it flourish. Yet 300,000 whales die in fishing gear every year. 

Who are WDC?
WDC, Whale and Dolphin Conservation are the leading global charity dedicated to the protection of whales and dolphins. 
Their mission is to reverse the global decline of whale and dolphin populations by creating safe seas for these creatures. And their vision is a world where every whale and dolphin is safe and free.
Their teams in the UK, Europe, the Americas, and Australasia work across the whole spectrum of threats, from climate breakdown to accidental entanglements in fishing gear, pollution, captivity and hunting and whaling. They bring together, and work hand-in-hand with, businesses, philanthropists, scientists, NGOs, governments and grassroots communities to find solutions to the problems faced by whales and dolphins.

What is ghost gear?
Ghost gear is fishing gear that has been lost or abandoned at sea. It’s a deadly menace to whales, dolphins and other marine life. 
When a whale or dolphin gets tangled in it, it can kill them in the most horrific way, by preventing them from getting to the surface to breathe. Or they can carry it for days, weeks or even months suffering a slow and painful death as it cuts into their skin, restricts their movement and hampers their ability to hunt and feed. 
But it’s difficult and expensive for fishers and other ocean users to dispose of gear they find at sea, or even to responsibly get rid of their own gear at the end of its life.
Did you know that about 1/3 of marine litter found in European seas is discarded fishing gear? That's estimated to be over 11,000 tonnes entering the sea each year!
It is a massive problem and so WDC are working on some innovative solutions.  

If you want to read more about WDC, you can do so here: https://whales.org/ 
Keep up to date with all the  gaming activities WDC does by signing up to their mailing list here: https://games.whales.org/#newsletter 
And you can find many other amazing games in the sale here: https://bit.ly/WODSale25  
Thank you for joining us and for supporting WDC!

notes.title: RAT MEMORY Early Access launch info
notes.content:
Hi, today I bring some info on RAT MEMORY Early Access, launching on August 12!
I'm preparing the game and adding more things to the full release, coming in Early 2025 hopefully.

WHAT CONTENT DOES THE EARLY ACCESS VERSION HAVE?

 16 character skins (including 4 that are in high-contrast);
 11 levels (from the 20 planned);
 8 languages (Chinese, English, French, German, Japanese, Portuguese, Spanish and Turkish).


WHAT'S PLANNED TO THE FULL GAME?

 9 more levels;
 Story mode with cutscenes and voice acting;
 More languages.


WHERE ARE THE MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS?
I didn't have time to test it on low-end PCs, but if your PC runs all demo levels, it will probably run the game too (demo 3 level is one of the most demanding levels in this game, so you can have a good idea by playing it).

HOW MUCH WILL IT COST?

 $7 in early access.
 Maybe $15 in the full game? I don't know yet.


I WANT TO COVER THE GAME, HOW CAN I CONTACT YOU?
Please send an email to contact.querogames@gmail.com with your info. Please have your email visible anywhere in your channel/site so I can confirm that you aren't a scammer. 

IS THERE A PRESS KIT?
Yes, here it is: Google Drive.

WHY DOES THIS GAME HAVE A DIFFERENT NAME IN SOME COUNTRIES?
I think it's more appropriated.

WHAT WILL HAPPEN AFTER THE FULL RELEASE?

 Console ports (if some publisher is interested on it);
 Maybe a pack with more levels?
 Maybe a sequel? (actually, I want to make a Stray-like game, but this is something in the future)


I hope this cover most of your questions. See you on August 12 (13 in Asia).

Please follow Quero Games on X and Youtube.

notes.title: Be the fastest in the new update and win the full game!
notes.content:
RAT MEMORY DEMO got a new update, that you can see here.

Playing the demo you have the chance to win the full game on the release date!

How to win:

Send me a screenshot of your fastest demo completion time via steam or Twitter.

You can just finish the second level, collecting just the required coins, or collect all coins.

The fastest time in each category will get a key of the full game on the release date (currently early 2023). Previous winners won't earn the prize again.

Good luck!

notes.title: Demo update 2.0 September 6 2022
notes.content:
First of all, sorry for the delay. I promised this update would be available in late August, but a critical bug prevented me to launch it. Now that the bug is fixed, I can publish it. Have fun!

This update for RAT MEMORY DEMO brings many improvements and some content!

NEW:
A new level!
This is a exploration level - find the coins in this not so colorful level to unlock the star.

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42467984/9d5722e3df0fae1bbe713de33bc88e8601ad03cd.png


 Added level selection menu in main menu.
 Added button to reset camera view.
 Added full gamepad support to menus.
 You can close menus with your pause button.
 Added some settings, like sensitivity of camera, ability to invert the camera controls, gamma correction and audio volume.
 Added checkpoints in old level.
 Added Quero Games logo in credits.


CHANGES:

 I changed the jump slightly - you should be able to reach the same height, but maybe at a lower speed Thanks for the feedback people!.
 The change above also fix the character staying forever in air when stuck in a border.
 Moved easter-egg in old level to a better position.
 Moved player starting point in old level to a better position.
 Changed color of default controls screen.
 Game size is lower - about 600 MB instead of 1.94GB.


FIXES:

 Camera has a different position. Thanks for the feedback people!
 Changed some visuals in old level. Thanks for the feedback people!
 Fix for a bug pressing ESC in main menu.


Please note that some texts aren't translated in all languages, and I'm sorry for this.

You can win the full game by playing this level! Details here

Follow Quero Games on Twitter for more updates and news.
